defect.description: PathJoin normalized dot components and repeated separators, but component checks used the raw destination byte length. Short missing parent components were skipped.
defect.regressionQualification: The original pre-OOM implementation already failed 20/48 cases. Commit 93894ad66 removed compensating duplicate directory creation and increased failures to 40/48. The additional final matrix catches both; this report does not present all 40 as a pre-existing defect.
defect.fix: Keep the original destination/link/type checks, then normalize once through xrtPathClean. Reuse that root for every entry and free it on the common exit after the static entry extractor returns.
defect.cost: One root string allocation/free per extraction reaching the entry loop, including empty archives. No per-entry normalization, body copy, new public API or new runtime layer.

allCasesVerify: existing file not overwritten by default
